test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below. (Left) 512 648 729 378 462 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the first digit of the lowest number is added to the third digit of the highest number?
solution:
Given : (Left) 512 648 729 378 462 (Right)

The first digit of the lowest number = **3**78.

The third digit of the highest number = 72**9**

**9 + 3 = 12.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
